kpis.description_fr: Production Steel Mills ~18 M tons. Plus gros producteur acier USA. Electric arc furnaces (EAF) = mini-mills modernes + low carbon footprint.
kpis.description_en: Steel Mills production ~18M tons. Largest US steel producer. Electric arc furnaces (EAF) = modern mini-mills + low carbon footprint.

kpis.description_fr: Steel Products = downstream (joist, deck, fasteners, rebar fab). Higher-margin specialty. Croissance modeste.
kpis.description_en: Steel Products = downstream (joist, deck, fasteners, rebar fab). Higher-margin specialty. Modest growth.

kpis.description_fr: Raw Materials = Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) Trinidad + Louisiana. Substitut scrap, donne sécurité approvisionnement EAF.
kpis.description_en: Raw Materials = Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) Trinidad + Louisiana. Scrap substitute, secures EAF feedstock.

kpis.description_fr: Prix moyen ~1000 $/ton 2024 (vs pic 1465 en 2022). Cycle commodity. 2024 = soft cycle, recovery attendue.
kpis.description_en: Avg ~$1000/ton 2024 (vs $1465 peak in 2022). Commodity cycle. 2024 = soft cycle, recovery expected.

kpis.description_fr: 52 années consécutives hausse dividende. Dividend Aristocrat S&P 500. Discipline distribution malgré cycle commodity.
kpis.description_en: 52 consecutive years of dividend increases. S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrat. Distribution discipline despite commodity cycle.
